correctedState: CONFIRMED as stated, with two refinements. (a) History: the env var arrived with v2.1.217, not v2.1.219 - the doc line carries a separate `min-version: 2.1.217` marker on the 'To change the limit' sentence, so v2.1.219 only raised the default from 1 to 3; configurability predates it. (b) The divergence is slightly larger than claimed: `orchestrator.depth` is documented as a knob (pi-agent-server/README.md:47) and is honoured end to end, but no host code path ever sets it - SessionManager.ts:4152-4163 omits `depth` from the execution-manifest seed - so in the shipped desktop and server product the ceiling is effectively fixed at 1 with no env var, no setting, and no UI to raise it, not merely defaulted to 1. Net effect: Claude's 'turn nesting off' value is our unconditional behaviour, and a depth-2 spawn fails with `Subagent depth limit exceeded (1)`. Additionally, the recorded closure in 2026-07-26-r-queue-doc-verification.md (R30) - 'default 1 ... already matched by P9's depth-1 fix, so this one is closed' - is now stale and should be reopened.
